name: VoxCPM
description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning
one_liner: An AI model that turns typed text into extremely natural-sounding speech in 30 languages, including the ability to design a brand-new voice from a description or clone someone's voice from a short clip.
buyer: An audiobook publisher, e-learning company, or indie game studio that needs large volumes of professional-sounding narration without hiring voice actors for every language.
business_use_cases: An audiobook publisher auto-narrates backlist titles into multiple languages overnight instead of booking voice-actor studio time per language.
An e-learning company dubs existing English course videos into Spanish, French, and other languages automatically, keeping a consistent 'instructor voice' across all of them.
An indie game studio generates hundreds of unique NPC voice lines from text descriptions alone, without a casting budget for background characters.

money_ideas.idea: Run a 'text-to-audiobook' service: upload a manuscript, get back narrated audio in a chosen voice, charge per finished hour of audio produced.
Offer a subscription dubbing and localization tool for course creators and YouTubers to translate and voice their content into multiple languages.

steal_this: Build a simple site: paste text or upload a PDF, pick a voice style, download narrated audio — charge per minute generated.
